mapper.select: SELECT id,aggregate_id AS product_id FROM catalog_event_outbox WHERE search_indexed_at IS NULL AND id <= #{throughId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_event_outbox WHERE search_indexed_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_event_outbox SET search_indexed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM catalog_search_documents WHERE generation=#{generation} AND product_id IN #{product}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_search_documents( generation,product_id,locale,merchant_id,business_version,name,brief,description,searchable,unit_price ) SELECT #{generation},p.id,'',p.merchant_id,p.business_version,p.name,p.brief,p.description, CONCAT_WS(' ',p.name,p.brief,p.description),p.price FROM products p UNION ALL SELECT #{generation},p.id,t.locale,p.merchant_id,p.business_version,t.name,t.brief,t.description, CONCAT_WS(' ',t.name,t.brief,t.description),p.price FROM products p JOIN product_translations t ON t.product_id=p.id
